import json,sys,http.client,pathlib,subprocess
sha="dc7318b0ea87d7820d55294fd7a08a56daaa89fb"
def need(ok,name):
 print(name+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:sys.exit(42)
def get(url,token):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 try:
  c.request("GET",url,headers={"Authorization":"Bearer "+token})
  r=c.getresponse();return r.status,r.read(200000)
 finally:c.close()
owner=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
st,body=get("/healthz",owner)
need(st==200 and json.loads(body).get("commit")==sha,"LIVE_REVISION")
st,body=get("/oauth/status",owner)
need(st==200 and json.loads(body).get("connected") is True,"OWNER_OAUTH_CONNECTED")
need(json.loads(body).get("can_publish") is False,"CONSENT_NEEDED_NOT_FORCED")
st,body=get("/app.js",owner)
need(st==200 and b'expected_text:editingOriginalText' in body
     and b'connect.textContent=' in body
     and b'draft.locked===true' in body,"LIVE_OWNER_EDITOR_AND_OAUTH")
st,body=get("/drafts",owner)
need(st==200 and isinstance(json.loads(body).get("drafts"),list),"EXISTING_DRAFT_STORE_READABLE")
for suite in ("test_drafts.py","test_publisher_runtime.py","test_account_runtime.py"):
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-B","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-p",suite,"-q"],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,timeout=45)
 need(p.returncode==0,"OFFLINE_"+suite)
print("REAL_TUMBLR_POST_REQUESTS=ZERO")
print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
PY
